A_per_parameter_thresholds.definition: one event per breaching parameter per reading

B_aggregate_band.definition: one event per reading whose band is not LOW

C_band_transition.definition: one event per upward band transition per patient

CAVEAT: These are event counts over a simulated stream. They are NOT a measurement of alert fatigue, clinician workload, diagnostic accuracy, or patient outcome, and must not be reported as such. Policy C emits fewer events by construction; whether that is clinically safe is unknown and untested here -- fewer notifications can mean missed deterioration.
